issue.title: CoderBench preflight reads the rewritten remote, so a host-wide insteadOf refuses a matching checkout
issue.body:
Found while running \`coderbench run devin-fan-out-six\` on a host whose global Git config carries a \`url.<proxy>.insteadOf https://github.com/\` rewrite.

## What happens

\`same_repository\` in \`crates/coderbench/src/preflight.rs\` asks \`git remote get-url origin\`, which applies \`insteadOf\` rewrites. The checkout's \`.git/config\` names \`https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents.git\`, the task names the same repository, and preflight still refuses:

\`\`\`
origin is https://git-manager.devin.ai/proxy/github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents.git
\`\`\`

The only workaround was \`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null\` for the run, which hides every other global setting too.

## What to do

- Read the configured URL, not the rewritten one: \`git config --get remote.origin.url\`, or \`git remote get-url --no-rewrite\`? Check what Git offers and pick the one that reports what the checkout's own config says.
- Keep \`bare()\` so SSH and HTTPS forms still compare equal.
- Add a test with a temporary repository whose global config (\`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL\` pointing at a file in the temp dir) carries an \`insteadOf\` rewrite: the check must pass against the configured URL.
- Note the change in \`docs/coderbench/\` where preflight is described, if a page describes the repository check.

## Acceptance

- A checkout whose configured origin matches the task passes preflight under an \`insteadOf\` rewrite.
- A checkout whose configured origin is a different repository still refuses.
- \`cargo test -p coderbench\` and strict Clippy pass.
